body.name: PsiTG
body.def: For every formal source \(U_C\), let \(D_C(p_T)=\{j\in C:Z_{\operatorname{src}(C,j)}(T,p_T)>0\}\).  The formula \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\) declares every directed and formal source incidence by the signs \(Z_e(T,p_T)>0\) or \(Z_e(T,p_T)=0\), discards empty \(D_C(p_T)\), merges equal nonempty realized child sets, and applies the finite latent-and-selection projection rules.  It imposes no simplex-vertex or literal table-constancy condition when \(D_C(p_T)=\varnothing\), and it is true exactly when \(G_S(M_{T,p_T})=G\).
